articles.preview_en: Photographer and former cellist Charles Brooks creates optical illusions with minuscule cameras.
articles.preview_ru: Photographer and former cellist Charles Brooks creates optical illusions with minuscule cameras.
articles.full_en: Photographer and former cellist Charles Brooks creates optical illusions with minuscule cameras. He threads endoscopes inside instruments to capture thousands of images which are then combined: a clarinet becomes a dark tunnel, a yidaki becomes a cave, a Steinway piano is a futuristic train station: ‘You’re also looking inside the history of these instruments … All the marks you’re seeing are from them being cleaned or repaired, or by the maker themselves’ Brooks’ latest exhibition, Architecture in Music, is on at Adelaide’s Immersive Light and Art until 5 December To be beside the sea: the joy of Australian beach rituals – in pictures Continue reading...
